evidence.reason: The dependency scanner explicitly enumerates [Unit] dependency directives that can bind a foreign unit to a CRQ unit, including stop/conflict relationships such as PartOf, BindsTo, and Conflicts. At the current tip, DEPENDENCY_RE omits systemd v257's StopPropagatedFrom= and PropagatesStopTo=, so a co-installed unit can reference a CRQ unit through stop propagation and evade discovery; the fence can then stop the co-tenant when it stops the CRQ unit. This is an implementation gap in the existing dependency scan, not a new requirement.
